text: The source architecture models repositories as typed research-software objects carrying capabilities, claims, evidence, tests, memory, policies and dependencies rather than as code folders only.
limitations: internal construction; not an external standard

text: CapabilityCell is defined in the source as C_i=(I,O,T,P,E,U,R,M): inputs, outputs, transformation, preconditions, evidence, uncertainty, resources and memory.
limitations: definition is source-internal; utility remains to be tested

text: A capability-centered IR is proposed to decouple semantic demand from concrete repository providers, with multiple implementations allowed for one capability contract.
limitations: provider substitution is a design goal, not yet an empirical success claim

text: The source proposes compiling natural-language research intent into an executable dynamic capability/repository graph.
limitations: general natural-language correctness is not established

text: Executable hyperedges are proposed as first-class orchestration objects connecting multiple capabilities, rather than descriptive dependency relations only.
limitations: formal semantics and baseline comparison remain incomplete

text: The source defines a Proof-Carrying Repository pattern in which claims, evidence, uncertainty, provenance, security and limitations travel with repository state.
limitations: not equivalent to formal proof-carrying code and not an external trust certification

text: The source explicitly separates ordinary Software CI, Semantic CI, Scientific CI and OAK, and states that passed software tests do not validate a scientific claim.
limitations: the effectiveness of the additional gates must be benchmarked

text: The source proposes Theory-to-Repo and Repo-to-Theory compilers linking formal research claims to code/tests/benchmarks/history in both directions.
limitations: semantic completeness of either compiler is unproved

text: Bidirectional compilation is defined as Theory <-> ExecutableSystem with a semantic difference intended to expose theory-implementation divergence.
limitations: a general metric for semantic difference is not yet validated

text: The source Constitution Kernel requires generation != truth, passed test != proven scientific claim, provenance for trust, preservation of M-minus and stronger validation for kernel changes.
limitations: governance rule, not a theorem of safe autonomy

text: The source frames architectural self-hosting as approximate reconstruction of a functionally equivalent ecosystem from its own schemas, manifests, capability graphs, tests and compilers.
limitations: no reconstruction score has yet been measured for the full ecosystem

text: The source proposes Residual-to-Theory compilation: residual -> competing explanations -> discriminating tests.
limitations: proposal existence is supported; discovery performance is untested

text: The source proposes a Theory -> Code -> Evidence -> RevisedTheory round-trip with residual Delta_T as a candidate correspondence diagnostic.
limitations: Delta_T has no validated universal semantics yet

text: The merged thesis factory produces exactly 2^n frontier PageNodes at depth n.
At depth 9 the existing PageTree yields exactly 512 frontier planning units.
The 512-node depth-9 frontier decomposes into exactly 256 sibling LOG/EXP research dyads.
limitations: planning structure only; not a claim about compiled page count or scientific quality

text: A second Tristan repository documents and implements a bounded Living Factory lineage using WorkUnits, capability genomes, typed outcomes, evidence bookkeeping, pattern mining, epistemic compilation and recursively governed sub-factories.
limitations: some evidence is synthetic/structural and explicitly not longitudinal or causal

text: The final thesis PDF contains exactly 512 compiled pages.
limitations: must be verified after complete LaTeX compilation

text: Capability routing scales better than manual all-to-all repository coupling under relevant workloads.
limitations: requires baseline and empirical measurement

text: Provider-independent Capability IR allows implementation substitution with fewer consumer changes than repository-specific integration.
limitations: requires matched provider contracts and controlled substitution trials

text: Reuse-first workflows reduce duplicate semantic implementations relative to generate-first workflows without degrading verified quality.
limitations: requires operational duplicate definition and controlled task set

text: Semantic and scientific CI detect meaningful theory-code/evidence mismatches missed by syntax-oriented tests at acceptable false-positive cost.
limitations: detection benefit and cost both require measurement

text: Historical GitHub activity alone is insufficient to identify causal research-method effects or a trustworthy learning reward.
limitations: supports a boundary on inference, not a claim that causal learning is impossible

text: The integrated mycelial systems calculus is scientifically novel relative to prior software architecture, intermediate-representation, proof-carrying-code, workflow/orchestration, self-adaptive-system and scientific-workflow literature.
limitations: requires systematic literature court; internal naming is not novelty evidence

text: GitHub implementation and passing tests alone do not establish scientific truth, causal superiority, external validation or novelty.
